footprint_independent_reproduction.comparison_dimensions: For every exact key: category, contact count and ordered source IDs, whole-cell containment flags, boundary-only flags, and intersection area within tolerance; per-feature totals are independently reported in the reproduction artifact.
footprint_independent_reproduction.method: Independent Python standard-library implementation directly compared with final footprint v2. Projects all source coordinates to the pinned grid, clips rings to each unit square for area (outer less holes), determines contact with closed-cell segment/vertex checks, checks all four corners against polygon outer/hole parity, and rejects whole-cell containment if any polygon ring enters the open cell interior. This covers holes, edge-only touches, and boundary crossings.

rules.center_and_footprint: Geometric source-polygon relations only. No current/legal applicability or physical qualification inference.
rules.disposition: Every interval remains pending; neither repair nor formal documented exception is accepted.
rules.physical_class: Preserve original physical class land as a retained original claim; no per-key current physical witness is present.
rules.territorial: IRL country-reference is contrary evidence, not sovereignty/current-boundary proof.

publication_note: The independent comparison file records its exact v2 comparator hash; v2 changed only its physical provenance references, not its computed geometry results.
